title: [16/09/2025] Internet users as percentage of population from 1999 to 2009
prompt: The line graph shows the percentage of the population in three different countries who used the internet between 1999 and 2009. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The line graph illustrates the proportion of people who accessed the internet in the USA, Canada, and Mexico over an 11-year period from 1999 to 2009.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, all three countries experienced an upward trend in internet usage throughout the given period. While Canada achieved the highest percentage by 2009, Mexico consistently remained the lowest among the three nations.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the two North American developed countries, in 1999, the USA had approximately 20% of its population using the internet, which was double Canada's figure at around 10%. The USA showed steady growth over the subsequent years, reaching approximately 52% by 2004 before continuing to rise more gradually to 76% in 2009. Canada, however, demonstrated a more dramatic increase, surging from its initial 10% to 60% by 2004, overtaking the USA around 2005, and ultimately reaching an impressive 96% by the end of the period.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding Mexico, this country started with the lowest internet penetration rate at merely 5% in 1999. Although it maintained consistent growth throughout the decade, the pace was considerably slower than its northern neighbors, rising to only 20% by 2004 and eventually reaching 40% in 2009, which was less than half of the USA's final figure.
